items.quote: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people
items.claim: Moses' father-in-law observed Moses performing judicial work
items.object: all that he did to the people

items.quote: he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
items.claim: Moses' father-in-law questioned why Moses alone bore the burden of judging the people

items.quote: Because the people come unto me to enquire of God
items.claim: The people came to Moses to inquire of God

items.quote: When they have a matter, they come unto me
items.claim: When disputes arose, the people came to Moses

items.quote: and I judge between one and another
items.claim: Moses rendered judgment between disputing parties

items.quote: and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws
items.claim: Moses instructed the people in God's statutes and laws
items.object: the statutes of God, and his laws
